title: Choose what your gift gives
summary: Donating for a friend? After paying, the thank-you page lets you choose which rewards go to them and which you keep. Your name stays on the boards unless you give that too.
highlights: Turn a donation you just made into a gift, for up to a day after paying
Pick which rewards your friend gets: Book Boosts, supporter perks, photo albums
The name box suggests players who have ridden the train, so the gift reaches the right person
